scope: componentwise candidate-world deletion under the current finite contract
interpretation_boundary: τ measures loss of current minimum-width realizations; κ measures loss of feasibility at any width. These are combinatorial robustness measures, not operational reliability or semantic necessity.

global_thresholds.certificate: Any one of the 58 singleton-private forced-world deletions makes the full cover infeasible.

degraded_width_semantics: For a tau-sized optimality-blocking deletion witness that remains feasible, degraded_minimum_width is the minimum surviving cover width. If no such witness remains feasible, the field is null; tau=kappa does not imply every tau-sized deletion is infeasible.
